adoption_labels.high_alt: High, other assignment: medium and small apartment buildings and the three houses cooled

prose.intro: Per building: what cooling adds, what warming saves in heating, how much of the cooling electricity solar covers, and what reaches the grid. All differences compare a cell with the heating-only cell of the same weather (the difference method), and heating saved by warming compares the heating-only cell in the scenario weather with the one in 2023 weather.
prose.rule_note: The solar coverage uses an allocation rule: in every hour solar power serves base load and hot water first, then the heat pump, then the battery. Allocating solar to the heat pump first is shown as a sensitivity. The rule is a bookkeeping choice, because the same kilowatt-hour of solar cannot be attributed to one load uniquely.
